chunks: From him, from Husayn ibn Hashim, from Ibn Muskan, from Zurarah, from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The time of Zuhr is at one cubit.

key_terms.الظُّهْرِ: the Zuhr prayer, the noon salat (prayer)
key_terms.ذِرَاعٍ: a cubit, a unit of measure used here to indicate prayer timing
key_terms.وَقْتُ: the appointed time or prescribed timing

ai.seo_question: When does the time of Zuhr prayer begin according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal indicator for the beginning time of Zuhr prayer. It places the time in relation to the measure of a cubit, which is part of the fiqh discussions on determining prayer times.
